provenance.edition-pin: v0.192, per the owner's registry-wide decision (CLAUDE.md: 'M3 pins the v0.192 token edition, everywhere... Decisions the owner has made — do not relitigate'). A mechanical diff of _md-comp-checkbox.scss across editions finds `latest` ADDS a `focus-indicator-*` family (colour/thickness/offset) not present in v0.192 — the same addition CHIP-MATRIX.md and CARD-MATRIX.md recorded for their own components. UNLIKE those components, checkbox does NOT lose its only focus affordance to this pin: v0.192 already carries a component-owned `focus-outline-color`/`focus-outline-width` pair (the box's own outline recolours and, for the unselected case, may widen on focus), because a checkbox's box already IS an outline-bearing element in every state, unlike a chip or a card. No other value differs between editions for this component.

provenance.state-opacities: md-sys-state.values(), v0.192: hover-state-layer-opacity 0.08, focus-state-layer-opacity 0.12, pressed-state-layer-opacity 0.12 — the SAME edition-dependent trio CLAUDE.md's foundations note flags ('M3 focus/pressed opacities are edition-dependent'); `latest` carries the identical 0.08/0.12/0.12 for this component specifically, so the pin changes nothing here even though it does elsewhere.
provenance.disabled-opacity: 'disabled-container-opacity' (renamed from 'unselected-disabled-container-opacity') AND 'selected-disabled-container-opacity' are BOTH 0.38 in this token set — a rare case where M3 does NOT split its disabled opacity by selection state (contrast badge.m3.json's disabled-label 0.38 / disabled-container 0.12 split). Applied only to the outline/background layers in real source (`:where(.disabled) .outline { opacity: ... }`, `:where(.selected.disabled) .background { opacity: ... }`) — never to the icon itself, which stays full-opacity even when disabled. This chassis applies the 0.38 at the ROOT level (see the template's style.box.disabled note) rather than per-layer, a declared simplification.
provenance.container-tokens: container-size: 18px (hardcoded literal, both editions); container-shape: 2px on all four logical corners (hardcoded literal); icon-size: 18px, EQUAL to container-size — the glyph fills the box with no margin. unselected-outline-width: 2px; selected-outline-width / selected-hover-outline-width / selected-pressed-outline-width / selected-focus-outline-width: ALL 0px — the outline is REMOVED, not merely recoloured, the instant the box becomes selected (the same fill-replaces-stroke mechanism CHIP-MATRIX.md documented for elevation@elevated and flat-selected).
provenance.state-layer-size-shape: state-layer-size: 40px, state-layer-shape: corner-full (9999px) — a full 40px circle centred on an 18px box, drawn by a separate md-ripple element this chassis does not reproduce (see structure.outline-layer / style.box.state-layer).
provenance.pressed-preview-finding: unselected-pressed-state-layer-color: primary (NOT on-surface, unlike unselected-hover/-focus which both use on-surface) — an unselected, currently-being-pressed checkbox ripples in the colour it is ABOUT TO BECOME. selected-pressed-state-layer-color: on-surface (NOT primary) — the mirror image, previewing the colour it is about to LOSE. A real, sourced, symmetrical piece of intent, not a coincidence.
provenance.real-native-input: checkbox.ts render(): `<input type="checkbox" id="input" aria-checked=${isIndeterminate ? 'mixed' : nothing} ... .indeterminate=${this.indeterminate} .checked=${this.checked} @input=${this.handleInput} @change=${this.handleChange} />` — a REAL native input, confirmed [S], not inferred. `handleInput` reads BOTH `target.checked` and `target.indeterminate` back off the native element after the browser resolves them.
provenance.form-participation: getFormValue() returns null when unchecked OR indeterminate, the checked value string otherwise; CheckboxValidator LAZILY instantiates a SECOND, invisible, real <input type="checkbox"> purely to borrow the browser's own constraint-validation engine (`this.checkboxControl.checked = state.checked; this.checkboxControl.required = state.required; return this.checkboxControl.validity`) — M3 delegates validity computation to native code rather than reimplementing it [S].
provenance.label-click-delegation: checkbox.ts constructor: `this.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (!isActivationClick(event) || !this.input) return; this.focus(); dispatchActivationClick(this.input) })`, importing `isActivationClick`/`dispatchActivationClick` from `internal/events/form-label-activation.js` — M3 explicitly anticipates being wrapped in a CONSUMER-authored <label> and redirects that click to its internal input, even though it renders no label of its own [S].
